title: Q-WORKERS-216: core/kgraph: tenant-agnostic knowledge graph whose gaps generate questions
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** issueloop and queue --run, daily
**Done check:** file:workers/core/kgraph/kgraph.test.js
**Status:** open

Moved from ultrastable/workers#216 (workers repo archived; code now under workers/ here, issues disabled on this repo).

Tenants (first: Practical Solutions) need a knowledge graph that drives knowledge generation, not only storage: typed nodes and edges with provenance, `gaps(rules)` and `questions(rules)` to turn missing relations into work for a loop, `propose`/`confirm` so a lead never counts as a fact, backlinks and bounded reach.

Scope: new `core/kgraph` (no tenant names, store port), boundary manifest entry. `core/graph` (code topology) is unchanged; its README lists non-code knowledge-graph nodes as NOT COVERED.

Closing probe: `core/kgraph/kgraph.test.js`.

**Closing probe:** `file:workers/core/kgraph/kgraph.test.js`
